grid_advice: no cold-start contamination expected: spend one throwaway 8-token warm-up request per arm before cell 1 is recorded (1 of 792), and discard nothing else; the first-touch penalty measured here is ~50 ms on a 5-token prompt (34% relative), which is exactly the size that a per-arm warm-up absorbs.
caveats: :8012 exposes no absolute process start time or uptime gauge; warm rests on cumulative counters (4,647 requests / 24.4M prefill tokens / 935K generated tokens, plus a 4,647-observation TTFT histogram) that a restart would have zeroed, and on a sub-200 ms first-token pair.
:8012 has no cumulative cache-credit counter; sglang:cache_hit_rate is a gauge for the last request and reads 0.0 when idle, so 'cache reported live' cannot be asserted from it.
usage objects from /v1/completions on :8012 carry no cached_tokens field (prompt/completion/total/reasoning only).
/health returned HTTP 200 with a 0-byte body on both ports today; the earlier 000/no-body observation was not reproduced. /v1/models is still the authority.
TTFT here is measured on a 5-token prompt; absolute values do not transfer to the grid's prompt lengths, only the shape (first-touch ~1.5x the repeat) does.
